section.catchline: Statement transmitted by county auditors to governing bodies -- Contents of statement.
section.subsection: The county auditor shall transmit to the governing bodies of taxing entities in which the property is located, or to which any of the value is apportioned, a statement of the valuation of all property as fixed and apportioned by the commission and reported under Section 59-2-802.
The statement under Subsection (1) shall contain the aggregate amount of taxable value placed in dispute in accordance with Section 59-2-1007.
The statement shall be transmitted at the same time and in the same manner as the statement is transmitted under Section 59-2-924.
